title: PR #6490 moved structure-board rendering into a new generic render_object_structure admin endpoint and dropped the user_can_change_page check the old details() path applied, so any staff user can read the plugin structure of pages they may not view.

findings.explanation: The diff contains no raw SQL construction. All data access goes through Django ORM calls (permission checks, pk comparisons, _get_descendants_ids()). No user-controlled input is interpolated into a SQL string.

The change adds missing authorization checks (source-side permission) to the copy-plugin and copy-placeholder flows, and adds a cycle-detection guard to the move-plugin flow. Before this patch, a staff user with write access to their own clipboard could copy plugins from any placeholder they could not read (IDOR/missing authz). The new checks call has_add_plugins_permission and check_source on the source placeholder before allowing the copy, closing the exfiltration vector. The cycle-detection guard prevents a DoS by rejecting moves that would create an ancestor loop. No authorization checks are weakened or removed.
